decision: Do not authorize a third probe-setup attempt. First collect bounded evidence about the attachment-menu transition, without staging a fixture, opening a chooser, or submitting a model request.

runtimeAdmission.sourceBinding: Capture this response's actual message ID and exact-body SHA-256. Bind the admission request to those values and this directiveId.
runtimeAdmission.failureAction: Stop controlled collection if admission is unavailable, malformed, denied, expired, or mismatched.

implementationDecision.supportingPattern: Playwright documents user-facing role locators and element-scoped screenshots. These support a narrowly scoped diagnostic, but do not prove that the installed browser client exposes the same methods. ([Playwright][1])

permittedWrites: This operational directive and a redacted checkpoint.
A narrowly scoped diagnostic projection and synthetic tests, only if the existing projection cannot record the authorized fields.
repositoryBoundary.privateEvidenceLocation: Existing private artifact store, outside public Git.
repositoryBoundary.verificationRule: Run applicable deterministic checks for changed code. Preserve previous verification receipts; do not represent them as proof of live UI behavior.

existingEvidenceInspection.scope: Operational command records and installed client documentation only.
fixedSources: The command sequence associated with the original failure event.
The command sequence associated with the recovery failure event.
An already retained command sequence for the previously confirmed archive delivery, if available through its existing receipt index.
collect: Browser-client version or contract identity when recorded.
Exact control selectors and supported timeout arguments.
Whether a call used a single click, multiple clicks, or a combined operation.
Recorded tab identity and command return status.
Whether the collector waited for a presumed text label before recording the actual menu state.
existingEvidenceInspection.payloadHandling: Project only operational fields. Do not emit prompt text, file contents, credentials, script payloads, or unrestricted command logs.
existingEvidenceInspection.missingHistoricalTrace: Record unavailable. Do not reconstruct missing commands from the current implementation or revisit old conversations.

liveDiagnostic.scope: One empty ordinary-chat composer and its attachment-menu control.
liveDiagnostic.tabRule: Use an existing empty task-owned diagnostic tab, or create at most one dedicated empty tab. Do not navigate away from or overwrite the Project Manager conversation or any unrelated draft.
preconditions: The intended tab and authorized account/profile are identifiable.
Message count, attachment count, and composer-content length are all zero.
No pending chooser operation or blocking native dialog is observed.
The installed client supports the required metadata-only operations.
procedure: Capture one bounded pre-interaction state sample from the empty composer and its visible interactive controls.
Identify the menu-navigation control from its actual rendered role and attributes. Do not presume that a historical upload-item label is currently present.
Proceed only if the control is uniquely identified as opening an in-page menu. If its behavior cannot be distinguished from directly opening a native chooser, stop without clicking.
Invoke that menu-navigation control once using the existing supported client.
Collect up to two bounded post-interaction state samples without another opening click, intervening navigation, composer fill, or upload-item activation.
Record the actual visible menu controls and state, including absence. Do not wait repeatedly for Add photos & files to become present.
If this diagnostic leaves its own in-page menu open, close only that positively identified menu through one supported, narrowly targeted action. Do not use global keystrokes.
Preserve the observations and stop before any chooser or probe operation.

metadataContract.scopeRestriction: Only the empty composer, its menu-navigation control, and the associated in-page menu. Do not enumerate the sidebar, history, Library, account menu, or unrelated page content.
metadataContract.samplingRule: Use an existing supported bounded projection that records current state. An absent menu or control is an observation, not a reason to rerun the interaction.
metadataContract.missingValueRule: Use null with an availability reason. Use false, zero, or an empty collection only when directly observed.

optionalVisualEvidence.scope: Directly captured element or region images of the verified empty composer and associated menu controls only.
exclude: Document names, previews, and recent-file suggestions.
optionalVisualEvidence.ifSafeDirectCropUnavailable: Record VISUAL_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE and return permitted metadata only.
optionalVisualEvidence.workerVisualInspection: Limited to the authorized empty UI controls.

safetyAndStopRules.unexpectedNativeChooser: Do not assign a file. Preserve the event and stop. Cancel only if existing supported controls positively identify it as this diagnostic's own empty chooser.
safetyAndStopRules.interactionTimeout: Do not repeat the click. Capture one remaining permitted read-only state sample only if browser control is still responsive, then stop.
safetyAndStopRules.unexpectedContentExposure: Stop the projection and record the incident without copying the exposed content.
safetyAndStopRules.menuOpensSuccessfully: Return the observations; success does not authorize uploading, changing the helper, or resuming P01.
safetyAndStopRules.globalBrowserFailure: Preserve collected evidence and report the exact technical blocker. Do not infer that owner action is necessarily required.

required: This directive's captured source identity and fresh runtime-admission receipt.
Preservation checks for the two prior failure receipts and frozen manifest.
The bounded command-sequence projection or explicit historical-trace unavailability.
The installed client contract identity and supported operations actually used.
Hashes of private diagnostic records and any permitted images.
Confirmation that no fixture was staged, no chooser was intentionally triggered, and no model request was submitted.
Confirmation that account settings, prior artifacts, and unrelated drafts remain unchanged.
completionEvidence.returnFormat: One operational JSON object. No substantive source content, marker values, private account text, or worker-authored root-cause conclusion.

exactDestination.submissionAmbiguity: Inspect destination message metadata without resending. Preserve an unresolved return instead of repeatedly clicking Send.

prohibitedActions: Treat this diagnostic as a third P01 setup attempt or resume any probe.
Stage a frozen prompt, fixture, private document, or attachment.
Activate an upload menu item, register a chooser waiter, or assign files.
Repair selectors, increase timeouts, or change upload behavior based on worker interpretation.
Use forced clicks, injected events, direct CDP, private endpoints, native-picker automation, or another transport.
Change accounts, profiles, permissions, extensions, personalization, or global settings.
Inspect substantive response text, documents, application scripts, or unrelated conversations.
Overwrite failure evidence or claim that an exhausted allowance has reset.
Publish private diagnostic material or ask the owner to relay it.
